question: What truth concerning the six-faced one was brought down to the goddess at that time?
premises: Something was brought down at that time.
It was brought down to you.
It concerns the truth of the six-faced one.
inference: The truth related to the six-faced one was then transmitted to the goddess.
uncertainties: The token tattvantu is morphologically unclear and may be a fused or irregular form.
The precise content of the truth transmitted is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Then that truth concerning the six-faced one was brought down to you.
